info.name: Get IPFS folder tree for the research object's root by dPID

params.name: version
params.description: Specific version index (e.g., `v3` or `2`) to resolve before reading the root CID

params.name: concurrency
params.description: Maximum number of concurrent DAG fetches

params.name: depth
params.description: Maximum directory depth to traverse. Use `full` for complete traversal, or a number (0=root only).

items.docs:
Resolves the given dPID to its manifest and returns the directory tree for the `root` component's CID.
Use `depth` to limit recursion for performance; use `full` for complete traversal.

info.name: Get IPFS folder tree by root CID

params.name: cid
params.description: Root CID of a UnixFS directory or file

params.name: rootName
params.description: Custom root label in the returned tree

params.name: concurrency
params.description: Maximum number of concurrent DAG fetches

params.name: depth
params.description: Maximum directory depth to traverse. Use `full` for complete traversal, or a number (0=root only).

items.docs: Returns the directory tree for a given UnixFS root CID. Use `depth` to limit recursion for performance; use `full` for a complete traversal.

info.name: Get IPFS folder tree for a specific path within a dPID

params.name: dpid
params.description: The dPID identifier followed by the path (e.g., 827/root/code)

items.docs:
Resolves the given dPID and navigates to a specific path within the root component.
For example: /v2/data/dpid/827/root/code will return just the 'code' directory.
